text.p: Santander Investment initiated coverage of Chilean supermarket chain Santa Isabel with a "market perform" rating on its shares.
Santander expects earnings per American Depositary Receipt of $1.50, $1.71 and $1.91 for 1997, 1998 and 1999 respectively, up from a reported $1.10 in 1996.
The 12- to 18-month target price of $34 implies 13 percent upside from the current level, said the report by analysts Paula del Sol and Heinrich Lessau.

The report cited Santa Isabel's expansion into other Latin American markets and expected increase in sales floor space, tempered by a decline in sales per square meter due to rising competition in Chile.
The Valparaiso-based chain operates 64 stores in Chile, 14 in Peru and four in Paraguay.
